name: Tensor Approximation
definition: A method approximating volume datasets using SVD/PCA-like tools, interpreting the volume as a tensor factorized into rank-one tensors (CP decomposition) or a core tensor and matrices (Tucker decomposition).
summary: Tensor Approximation compresses volume data by factorizing it into basis matrices and a core tensor, distinguishing itself from wavelets by capturing non-axis aligned features and from Tucker Decomposition by its integration into a multiresolution octree hierarchy.
